<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918708_theRebbe_155" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918708_theRebbe_155__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the three levels in Ein Sof above the hidden Sefiros, distinguishing between two types of concealment—one that exists in actuality and one that does not—using the analogies of fire in coal versus fire in flint, and applying this to the hidden Sefiros.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter of the three aforementioned levels in Ein Sof that are above the hidden Sefiros</t>
    <t s="2">[after it arose in His will that there be a place of grasp for the elevation of Mayin Nukvin</t>
    <t s="3">[that even this level is above the hidden Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="4">since the hidden Sefiros are the "faces" that were made in Ein Sof through</t>
    <t s="5">(after)</t>
    <t s="6">the elevation of Mayin Nukvin],</t>
    <t s="7">as it is from His own essence</t>
    <t s="8">(before the aforementioned arising of the will)</t>
    <t s="9">that in this level the elevation of Mayin Nukvin does not apply,</t>
    <t s="10">and the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof where the matter of the elevation of Mayin Nukvin is rooted]</t>
    <t s="11">in more detail,</t>
    <t s="12">will be understood by prefacing the manner of the concealment of the hidden Sefiros47.</t>
    <t s="13">For in concealment there are two manners48,</t>
    <t s="14">a concealment that exists in actuality,</t>
    <t s="15">like fire that is within a coal,</t>
    <t s="16">that despite being hidden and covered in the coal, it is an actuality of fire,</t>
    <t s="17">and therefore to reveal it from its concealment no exertion is needed</t>
    <t s="18">(for by blowing on the coal the fire is revealed).</t>
    <t s="19">And a concealment that does not exist in actuality,</t>
    <t s="20">like fire that is in a flintstone,</t>
    <t s="21">that it is not an actuality of fire but only the potential of fire,</t>
    <t s="22">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="23">the extraction of fire from the flint is by striking,</t>
    <t s="24">with exertion and effort.</t>
    <t s="25">And in the powers of the soul is the distinction between hidden powers and powers that are included in the soul.</t>
    <t s="26">For the concealment of hidden powers,</t>
    <t s="27">like the power of the intellect,</t>
    <t s="28">is a concealment that exists in actuality,</t>
    <t s="29">and the concealment of powers that are included in the soul,</t>
    <t s="30">like the power of the primal, essential intellect,</t>
    <t s="31">is a concealment that does not exist in actuality.</t>
    <t s="32">And the concealment of the hidden Sefiros is a concealment that does not exist in actuality49.</t>
    <t s="33">For that the Sefiros that are above Atzilus are hidden and concealed is because they are included in Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="34">in the manner of the inclusion of powers in the soul,</t>
    <t s="35">and the concealment of powers that are included in the soul is a concealment that does not exist in actuality,</t>
    <t s="36">as above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that even a concealment that does not exist in actuality has some existence as a source, but regarding the higher levels of hidden Sefiros above the Akudim, they have no existence at all—only the potential for the Sefiros to come into being, like the name of a person which only creates a new capacity to respond when called.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And behold, even a concealment that does not exist in actuality is some existence,</t>
    <t s="1">except that its existence is that it is a source for existence.</t>
    <t s="2">And like the potential of fire that is in a flintstone,</t>
    <t s="3">which is a potential and source for fire.</t>
    <t s="4">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="5">that this that there is in the flint a potential for fire is something additional to the flint.</t>
    <t s="6">And likewise it is with the powers that are included in the soul,</t>
    <t s="7">that they are powers</t>
    <t s="8">(and not the soul),</t>
    <t s="9">and furthermore,</t>
    <t s="10">that they are like a source for the revealed powers.</t>
    <t s="11">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="12">the analogy of the powers included in the soul for the hidden Sefiros is regarding the Sefiros of Akudim,</t>
    <t s="13">but regarding the levels of the hidden Sefiros that are above Akudim50,</t>
    <t s="14">it is not applicable to say even that they are in a concealment that does not exist in actuality,</t>
    <t s="15">but rather they are not an existence at all,</t>
    <t s="16">as the expression</t>
    <t s="17">(brought in many places51)</t>
    <t s="18">"there is no existence to the hidden ones."</t>
    <t s="19">For that which is innovated in the matter of the hidden Sefiros is only capability—that there can be the coming into being of Sefiros, and as long as the Sefiros have not come into being, there is no existence of Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="20">nor even an existence of a source for the Sefiros.</t>
    <t s="21">And the analogy for this is from the name of a person52,</t>
    <t s="22">that that which is innovated in the person by his having a name is only that if they call him by his name he will turn</t>
    <t s="23">(draw forth)</t>
    <t s="24">to those who call him.</t>
    <t s="25">For the existence of this drawing forth</t>
    <t s="26">(that he turns to those who call him by his name)</t>
    <t s="27">begins at the time that they call him by his name,</t>
    <t s="28">and before they call him by his name there is no existence of the drawing forth,</t>
    <t s="29">nor even a source for the drawing forth,</t>
    <t s="30">and that which is innovated by his having a name is only capability—that the drawing forth of his turning to those who call him by his name can be.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as a person's name creates a new capacity, so too the ten hidden Sefiros are ten names of God, and by calling upon these names the Sefiros themselves are brought into existence from absolute non-existence, unlike in a human where calling a name only reveals a pre-existing power.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And behold, just as it is regarding the name of a person</t>
    <t s="1">(Reuven,</t>
    <t s="2">Shimon),</t>
    <t s="3">so too it is regarding names of attribute and quality,</t>
    <t s="4">for when they call a person by the name "wise" or "pious" and the like,</t>
    <t s="5">by these praises they arouse the power of wisdom and kindness within him to be drawn from concealment to revelation.</t>
    <t s="6">And it is explained in Torah Ohr53</t>
    <t s="7">and in several discourses54,</t>
    <t s="8">that the ten hidden Sefiros are ten names,</t>
    <t s="9">that by calling upon them,</t>
    <t s="10">the coming into being of the Sefiros will occur.</t>
    <t s="11">And this means,</t>
    <t s="12">that when it arose in His will, blessed be He, to bring the Sefiros into being,</t>
    <t s="13">He first emanated ten names55,</t>
    <t s="14">whose entire matter is only that when they call upon Him, blessed be He, with one of these names,</t>
    <t s="15">then there will come into being</t>
    <t s="16">(by the calling)</t>
    <t s="17">that Sefirah that is related to this name</t>
    <t s="18">[for by calling Him by the name "Wise",</t>
    <t s="19">the Sefirah of Chochmah will come into being,</t>
    <t s="20">and by calling Him by the name "Pious",</t>
    <t s="21">the Sefirah of Chessed will come into being]</t>
    <t s="22">— analogous to a person,</t>
    <t s="23">that by calling him "wise" and "pious",</t>
    <t s="24">a drawing forth of wisdom and kindness is made.</t>
    <t s="25">Except that in a person,</t>
    <t s="26">the drawing forth by calling him "wise" and "pious",</t>
    <t s="27">is only from concealment to revelation,</t>
    <t s="28">but Above,</t>
    <t s="29">by the calling of the names, the very existence of the Sefiros is made,</t>
    <t s="30">for before the calling there were no Sefiros at all,</t>
    <t s="31">even not in concealment.</t>
    <t s="32">In the manner of the drawing forth that is by calling a person's name</t>
    <t s="33">(that he turns when they call him by his name),</t>
    <t s="34">whose entire existence is made by the calling of the name, and before the calling of the name it was not in concealment</t>
    <t s="35">(as above).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
